meta.chiplet_cap_pages_note: Scaled-down per-chiplet DRAM capacity to prevent degenerate 'all pages on one chiplet' plans. 400 pages * 4096B = 1,638,400 bytes (~1.56MiB) per chiplet. For 4 chiplets, total capacity ~6.25MiB, enough for current small CNN/Transformer benches; adjust when scaling workloads.
meta.chiplet_overflow_note: Soft overflow tier for hot low-parallel buffers. Lets the planner exceed chiplet_cap_pages when remote-traffic savings dominate, but charges an extra per-page penalty. Useful for small FC / norm hot spots without fully removing capacity discipline.
